C0633.title: Taobao Duplicate Listings Caused Store Restriction on Publishing Products
C0633.summary: A newly registered Taobao store was restricted from publishing products because another store under the same identity was found to have duplicate listings across multiple stores, triggering associated risk controls that flagged the new store as a security risk immediately after registration.

references.title: What causes newly opened Taobao stores to be restricted from publishing products? _ New store _ Deposit _ Violation
